column1: # binary<TAB>CI seconds: tests kept in one shard because they overlap when run together.
# attribute_seeded: its 11 tests overlap in one process; the whole block took 475, 505, 575 and 721 s on CI (AET-WO-1908 FEEDBACK), 1377 s alone. Weighed at the worst sample.
# AET-WO-1909: each of these binaries reads one shared run (common::verify::Shared), which pays only inside one process.
# Provisional weights, from the CI seconds of the tests they replace, until CI measures each block (ci/shard.sh REFIT RULE step 3):
# verify_2k2_tier2: two verify runs (--against --fab-out) and a build, a campaign and an emit; 2 x 258 s, the worst verify seen, + 10.
# against_fab_tier2: one --fab-out verify, then one --against-fab verify per test, one at a time; 3 x 227 s.
# verify_47k_tier2: one verify (47k, --fab-out); 218 s, the worst sample of the tests it replaces.
# campaign_tier2: first() (one campaign of 2k2 and 47k) once instead of once per shard; serial in one process 39.9 s on Furnace x 2.08.
